title: AgentOS skill manifest
description: YAML front-matter of a portable SKILL.md package. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (semver syntax, name equals directory, invocation consistency, dependency resolution) are enforced by `agentos skills validate`.

description.description: Concise description used for discovery (the body is loaded only when selected).

version.description: Semantic version of the skill, e.g. "0.1.0". Quote it in YAML.

kind.description: `skill` (default) or `router` (selects among `routes` by their declared triggers).

invocation.description: Explicit invocation mode. Must agree with user_invocable / model_invocable when those are also set.

user_invocable.description: The human may explicitly request this skill. Default: true.

model_invocable.description: The agent may choose this skill autonomously. Default: false (never implicit).

disable-model-invocation.description: Native-host control used by Cursor and Claude Code. true means the host must not invoke the skill on its own. It must agree with model_invocable and never widens it. Optional; adapter install writes true onto user-only skills under .agents/skills/.

requires.description: Skills that must run before this one, with optional semver constraints.

optional_recommends.description: Skills that are useful alongside this one but not required (not part of the execution order).

routes.description: Router skills only: the skills this router selects among.

tools.description: Abstract tool names the skill uses (e.g. "test-runner", "vcs").

permissions.description: Capabilities the skill needs. Anything not listed is denied.

references.description: Relative paths (forward slashes, no `..`) of reference files inside the skill directory, loaded only when needed.

eval_cases.description: Routing examples that must hold for this skill.

expect.description: `top` (default): the skill ranks first; `ranked`: it is ranked; `not_ranked`: it is not ranked.

skill.description: Skill the expectation is about. Defaults to this skill; required for routers.
